title: Commercial Plaza & Boutique Hotel
tagline: Ground-floor retail arcade with luxury upper boutique hospitality suites
description: A mixed-use commercial development strategically positioned on a busy urban corridor in Ambikapur. Features ground-level retail storefronts with recessed roller shutters and upper floors accommodating a contemporary boutique hotel with modular ACP and stone facade paneling.

details.Key Elements: Ground Retail Arcade, Hotel Suites, Modular ACP Grid Facade, Corner Circulation
